تستغلون (form X)
# تَسْتَغِلُّونَ (tastaḡillūna) /tas.ta.ɣil.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
# تُسْتَغَلُّونَ (tustaḡallūna) /tus.ta.ɣal.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَغَلَّ (istaḡalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
